{{Quote|Aw, quit fiddling with the power flux stabilizer. I just re-tuned it last week. And if you keep maxing out the drives we're going to have a burn-out.|A [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]]|<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>}}
A '''power flux stabilizer''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component. [[Technician/Legends|Technicians]] were required to keep them tuned as part of their maintenance cycle.<ref name="PSG" />
